question: What enjoyment follows from attracting many divine maidens in this practice?
premises: Many divine maidens can be attracted.
Enjoyment is experienced as a result.
inference: Having attracted many divine maidens, they enjoy them, O beloved.
uncertainties: subject of bhuñjate is ambiguous; may refer to practitioners or the maidens in context
plain_english: Having attracted many divine maidens, they enjoy them, O beloved.
